card.description:
You have finally reached the climax of your adventure inside the Cursed Fortress. This card represents the achievement of your final goal and the conclusion of the narrative mission. By activating this event, the match will officially transition to the ENDED state, allowing you to view the summary of your story
. Every choice you made along the misty corridors has led you to this glorious milestone. Congratulations, you have proven that your destiny is forged only by your actions.
card.title: Complete story

card.description:
Welcome to the introduction match of paths.games.

Here you can constantly check your vital statistics such as Life, Energy, and Happiness.

Examine the movement section to discover which adjacent locations are ready to be explored.

Browse the list of available actions to interact with your current location and advance the story.

Remember that every choice consumes resources and uniquely shapes your winding path
card.title: Tutorial start location

card.description:
This is the tutorial location when you can complete the story.

Execute the ending action to complete the story or back in other locations to explore.
card.title: Ending location

card.description:
This is the center location of tutorial story.

Explore all location.
card.title: Center location

card.description:
You are in a protected shelter, a rare moment of respite from the dangers lurking in the shadows. In a safe place, resting allows you to regenerate your statistics exceptionally compared to dangerous areas
. You will recover Energy based on your Dexterity and Life based on your physical Constitution
. Furthermore, the peaceful atmosphere will promote a significant reduction in your Sadness level. Use this space wisely to best prepare yourself before the start of the next time cycle
.
card.title: Safe location

texts.longText: A cursed fortress rises from the mist. Brave souls are needed to uncover its dark secrets before the ancient evil consumes the realm. Every corridor hides a choice, every choice shapes your fate.

texts.longText:
Welcome to the Paths Alpha tutorial.

This short adventure is designed to teach you the core mechanics of Paths Games while you explore a cursed fortress rising from the mist.
You will learn how to manage your Energy, navigate between adjacent locations, and use your character's Traits and Stats to overcome narrative challenges. Step inside and discover how every choice shapes your destiny.

Welcome to the Paths Games tutorial: your journey begins now.
On the left side of your screen you'll see the location description telling you about the place where you stand.
On the right side is your character information card displaying your vital statistics: Life, Energy, and Happiness.
Below that you'll find two sections: the list of available movements to adjacent locations and the list of actions you can perform. Once you've reviewed all this information, choose a direction or action to progress.
Each movement and action shapes your unique story.

texts.longText:
Benvenuto nel tutorial di Paths Games: il tuo viaggio inizia ora.
Sul lato sinistro dello schermo vedrai la descrizione del luogo che ti racconta del posto in cui stai.
Sul lato destro c'è la tua carta informazioni personaggio con le tue statistiche vitali: Vita, Energia e Felicità.
Sotto troverai due sezioni: l'elenco dei movimenti disponibili verso i luoghi adiacenti e l'elenco delle azioni che puoi eseguire.
Una volta che hai esaminato tutte queste informazioni, scegli una direzione o un'azione per progredire.
Ogni movimento e azione modella la tua storia unica.

texts.longText:
You are in a protected shelter where you can rest and recover.
Sleeping here restores Energy based on your difficulty level—up to 4 points on Easy mode.
Your Life recovers based on your Constitution stat, and your Sadness decreases significantly.
This is one of the few places where you can recover safely.
Use Safe Locations strategically—sometimes they cost Energy to reach, so plan your journey carefully. Return here when your resources are depleted.

texts.longText:
Sei in un rifugio protetto dove puoi riposare e recuperare.
Dormire qui ripristina l'Energia in base al tuo livello di difficoltà—fino a 4 punti in modalità Facile.
La tua Vita si recupera in base al tuo stat Costituzione, e la tua Tristezza diminuisce significativamente.
Questo è uno dei pochi posti dove puoi recuperare in sicurezza.
Usa i Luoghi Sicuri strategicamente—a volte costano Energia per raggiungerli, quindi pianifica il tuo viaggio con cura. Torna qui quando le tue risorse sono esaurite.

texts.longText:
This is the central hub of the tutoral journey where multiple ways converge.
When you explore new locations, only their direction is shown—North, South, East, West.
Once you visit a location, its name appears so you can return easily. Use your map to plan your journey and see all the places you've visited.
Each movement costs Energy based on the difficulty of the terrain. Plan wisely which path to take next.

texts.longText:
You stand on windswept hills.
Here you can interact with the environment through Actions—these are special opportunities to test yourself and gain rewards.
Each action costs Energy and its success depends on your character's statistics.
Try an action to see what happens and how the game resolves your choices.
Pay attention to the results—they tell you a story about what your character accomplished. Some actions might seem easy, others challenging.

texts.longText:
Ti trovi su colline ventose.
Qui puoi interagire con l'ambiente attraverso le Azioni—queste sono opportunità speciali per mettere alla prova te stesso e guadagnare ricompense.
Ogni azione costa Energia e il suo successo dipende dalle statistiche del tuo personaggio.
Prova un'azione per vedere cosa succede e come il gioco risolve le tue scelte.
Presta attenzione ai risultati—ti raccontano una storia su ciò che il tuo personaggio ha realizzato. Alcune azioni potrebbero sembrare facili, altre più difficili.

texts.longText:
You've wandered onto a twisted path where the stones beneath your feet seem to shift and twist in unnatural ways.
The air feels different here, charged with an energy you can't quite understand.
Tall trees loom overhead, their branches creating patterns that hurt your eyes if you stare too long.
The path itself seems to lead somewhere specific, but its destination remains unclear.
Some say those who follow strange paths discover shortcuts others have missed. Trust your instincts here.

Sei finito su un sentiero contorto dove le pietre sotto i tuoi piedi sembrano spostarsi e attorcigliarsi in modi innaturali.
L'aria qui sembra diversa, carica di un'energia che non riesci a comprendere completamente.
Alberi alti si ergono sopra la tua testa, i loro rami creano motivi che feriscono gli occhi se li guardi troppo a lungo. Il sentiero stesso sembra portare da qualche parte di specifico, ma la sua destinazione rimane poco chiara.
Alcuni dicono che chi segue sentieri strani scopre scorciatoie che altri hanno perso. Fidati del tuo istinto qui.

The place feels peaceful and forgotten, untouched by time and the chaos of the fortress.

Beware: not all paths in the fortress are bidirectional. Some movements lead only forward—once you leave this place through certain directions, you cannot return the way you came. Always check on map your available movements carefully before stepping forward into the unknown.

title: Paths Tutorial

en.description: Unwavering courage that fears no danger. An iron will that inspires steadiness even in the most desperate situations.
en.name: Brave

it.description: Coraggio incrollabile che non teme il pericolo. Una volontà di ferro che ispira fermezza anche nelle situazioni più disperate
it.name: Coraggioso

en.description: An agile mind and quick reflexes. The ability to turn every situation to your advantage with wit and speed.
en.name: Cunning

it.description: Mente agile e riflessi pronti. La capacità di volgere ogni situazione a proprio vantaggio con ingegno e rapidità
it.name: Furbo

en.description: Marked by a dark fate, this burden weighs on the soul but can awaken latent powers at a terrible price.
en.name: Cursed

it.description: Segnato da un destino oscuro, questo fardello grava sull'anima ma può risvegliare poteri latenti a un prezzo terribile
it.name: Maledetto

en.description: Touched by divine grace, you walk under a protective light that mitigates adversity and instills hope.
en.name: Blessed

it.description: Toccato dalla grazia divina, cammini sotto una luce protettrice che mitiga le avversità e infonde speranza
it.name: Benedetto

en.description: Survival above all else. The readiness to flee allows you to avoid blows that would strike down the boldest.
en.name: Coward

it.description: La sopravvivenza prima di tutto. La prontezza nel fuggire permette di evitare colpi che abbatterebbero i più audaci
it.name: Codardo

en.description: The blood of a forgotten era flows through your veins, awakening lost knowledge and legendary resilience.
en.name: Ancident

it.description: Il sangue di un'epoca dimenticata scorre nelle vene, risvegliando conoscenze perdute e una tempra leggendaria
it.name: Divino
